name: payment-native
why: The most common operation; the exact sentence must state the amount, asset, and destination.

name: create-account
why: Exercises the starting-balance branch, distinct from payment.
expectDescription: Create account {NEW_ACCOUNT} with starting balance 25.0000000 XLM

name: set-options-signer-and-threshold
why: Exercises describeSetOptions' multi-field branch (signer + threshold together), safety-relevant because it changes the account's own multisig setup.
expectDescription: Set account options: master key weight null; low threshold null; medium threshold 2; high threshold null; set flags null; clear flags null; signer {SIGNER} (weight 1)

name: change-trust
why: Exercises assetLabel's non-native code:issuer branch via a trustline limit change.
expectDescription: Set trustline for USD:{ISSUER} with limit 1000.0000000

name: allow-trust
why: Exercises the authorize-flag formatting branch (parsed as a number, not a boolean).
expectDescription: Set trust authorization for USD held by {TRUSTOR} (authorize=1)

name: account-merge
why: A single-field operation with real safety weight: merging an account is irreversible.

name: path-payment-strict-send
why: Exercises the dual-asset, dual-amount path-payment branch, distinct from a simple payment.
expectDescription: Send exactly 10.0000000 XLM to {DEST} delivering at least 5.0000000 USD:{ISSUER}

name: bump-sequence
why: A minimal single-field operation, useful as a baseline for the exhaustiveness switch.

name: manage-sell-offer
why: Exercises the offer/price formatting branch shared by the DEX operation family.
expectDescription: Place sell offer: sell 100.0000000 XLM for USD:{ISSUER} at price 1.5 (offer 0)

name: invoke-host-function-fallback
why: Safety case: Soroban operations are not decoded into plain language in v1, and the fallback sentence must never silently disappear or claim more than it knows.
expectDescription: Invoke a Soroban smart contract function
